reason: With a default namespace http://example.org/, the identifiers e1 and a1 flatten to the absolute IRIs http://example.org/e1 and http://example.org/a1, and the entity keeps its type and its qualifiedGeneration edge. A default-namespace identifier must expand to an absolute IRI under the default namespace, and a bare identifier resolves against @base, so the writer must emit @base next to @vocab (PROV-JSONLD submission, section 4).

After the pyld flattening of the output in url and embed mode, an entity has the type prov:Entity and the property prov:qualifiedGeneration, and an activity's start time is an xsd:dateTime value 2011-11-16T16:05:00. The vendored PROV-JSONLD submission context defines the expanded IRIs, so output must expand to the PROV-O terms and the xsd:dateTime datatype.

After the pyld flattening in url and embed mode, an entity's prov:label Literal bonjour with the language tag fr is the value bonjour with the language fr under rdfs:label. The PROV-JSONLD submission context maps the label to rdfs:label and keeps the language tag, so output must expand to a language-tagged value.

For the document of #545 the pyld expansion in url and embed mode gives the triples about ex:arthur and ex:shed that the PROV-O writer gives, with foaf:pastProject as the IRI ex:shed and the two rdf:type values prov:Agent and prov:Person. The JSON-LD output of an agent with additional types and external-vocabulary attributes must agree with the PROV-O output on the node triples (#545).
